procedure_name: Property Mutation (Transfer of Title in Revenue Records)
summary: Official update of municipal and revenue land ownership records following property purchase, gift, inheritance, or partition.

steps.title: Gather registered transfer deed
steps.description: Obtain certified copy of Registered Sale Deed, Gift Deed, Relinquishment Deed, or Probate of Will.

steps.title: Apply online on Revenue Portal
steps.description: Submit mutation application providing property unique identification number (UPRN), seller and buyer particulars.

steps.title: Issuance of 15-day public notice
steps.description: Patwari/Tehsildar issues a 15-day public notice to invite objections from legal heirs or co-sharers.

steps.title: Verification of possession
steps.description: Field revenue inspector inspects property to verify actual physical possession.

steps.title: Tehsildar sanction and Jamabandi update
steps.description: Tehsildar sanctions mutation order; property record is updated in the computerized Jamabandi / RoR.
